Topic: UK small business AI use has more than doubled this year, to 47%
Caption Notes:
47% of UK small business owners now use AI, up from 22% a year ago. Most use it to write content, solve problems and cut admin. But fewer than 1 in 5 feel very confident using AI, and security worries hold many back. If you're using it but unsure where to start, our guides cover the basics: ainofluff.co.uk/shop.html

Source: Simply Business SME Insights Report 2026, survey of 1,842 UK small business owners.

Topic: Someone in Northern Ireland loses £250,000 to an AI deepfake investment scam
Caption Notes:
Someone in Northern Ireland has lost £250,000 to a scam that started with an AI-generated video of a well-known financial personality. Police say these fake videos are getting harder to spot. 4 warning signs:

1. A celebrity video promoting an investment
2. A small first payment that seems to work
3. The chat moving to WhatsApp
4. A request for remote access to your computer

See any of these? Stop, and check with the person or company directly before you send money. Follow @ainofluff for more plain-English AI safety updates.

Source: PSNI, 7 Sep 2026.
